listings.thesis: HBM/server DRAM/eSSD leader with record profits and AI-led pricing power. Strong alpha, though recent share-price records mean the crowd is catching on.

priorCase.rankRationale: AI-node bottleneck lens: June 18 HBM4E 12-layer samples plus reaffirmed ~70% Nvidia HBM4 allocation and a worsening H2-2026 shortage genuinely strengthen the choke-point case vs June 9. But it's now ~$1T cap, 277% YTD, deeply crowded; fundamentals warrant only modest positive drift, not a re-rank.

listings.thesis: HBM is a gating item for AI clusters; CPO tailwind is indirect but strong cluster-scale AI proxy.

priorCase.rankRationale: CPO lens: SK hynix is only an indirect cluster-scale proxy here. HBM4E sample news doesn't change its co-packaged-optics relevance, and at ~$1T cap heavily re-rated it should stay below purer, less-crowded CPO names. No change to the indirect-proxy thesis since June 9.
